entries.title: Charging and Discharging Parallel-Plate Capacitor
entries.description: Show two large parallel metal plates facing each other where glowing particle “charges” transfer from a battery object onto the plates, building an electric field visualized by animated field lines, with a voltmeter bar that rises and falls as the capacitor charges and discharges through a resistor block.
